title: Cabin — Two-Stage Bin Latch and Load Placard Change Without Shell Replacement
abstract: Latch-only version of the overhead stowage change for operators keeping the delivered bin shell, fitting the two-stage latch and correcting the bay placard without touching the tie rods.

sections.planning_reason: Not every operator wants the deeper bin, but the latch that fails to stay closed in flight affects the whole fleet and generates a cabin crew report every time it happens. One operator asked for the latch on its own so that it could take the reliability benefit without a cabin down-time it could not schedule. The bay placard is also incorrect on a small number of aircraft where a previous cabin change was recorded but the placard was not updated, and this bulletin corrects that at the same visit.
sections.description: The bulletin fits the two-stage latch to the delivered bin shell and verifies or corrects the bay load placard. No shell, tie rod or trim work is done.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open each bin and support the door. Remove the delivered latch and its striker. Install the two-stage latch and set the lift-before-release travel with the gauge. Check the door closing force and adjust the gas strut where the task requires it. Do the closing and retention check at every bay and record any bay that fails. Compare the bay placard with the aircraft configuration file and replace it where the two disagree. Do the cabin securing check with the cabin crew procedure. Record the embodiment and the placard state per bay.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-13 aircraft from MSN C00205 to MSN C00612 that retain the delivered bin shell. Aircraft that have accomplished Service Bulletin CRN-25-2006 already carry the two-stage latch and are not affected. This is a partial embodiment of the modification and the weight change does not apply.
sections.material_note: Kit K2520-2011-01 contains the latches, the strikers and a placard set. Lead time is six weeks. Removed latches are not returned. Because only the latch is fitted, the weight change of the full modification does not apply to this bulletin.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled cabin check, or within thirty-six months of the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
